LanguageData.HiveLord_Summon.label: Summon Hive Lord
LanguageData.HiveLord_Summon.description:
Call a hunter from beneath the ground. Summon a Hive Lord on open, unroofed ground to serve the user's faction and pursue enemies across the map.

It has half the size and attack area of a normal Hive Lord, one-third of its maximum health, and unchanged attack damage. It cannot harm or knock back allies and takes at most 100 health damage per hit.

Cast range: 30 cells. Cast time: 1.5 seconds. Duration: one day. Cooldown: 15 days. Its death or expiry grants no hunting reward.
